ex.q: Where do we stand out against rivals?
ex.a:
From the Huxley website: work from home lounge with personal offices, conference room with a Miele coffee bar, billiards room, rooftop deck with grills, pet spa and grooming, dog park, gated garage parking and a resort style pool and spa.
  • Google rating: 4.5, above Residences Kierland (4.0), Broadstone Scottsdale Quarter (2.9) and The Core Scottsdale (2.7).
  • Broadstone does not list a coworking space or game room in the market data.

ex.q: Who showed the tour? Pending service requests?
ex.a: Tour agents and service requests live in your property management system, which is not connected to this app. Tours you log in Tour mode are on your desk list.

We cannot see each person’s reason, but here is what they see when they compare you:
  • Broadstone Scottsdale Quarter has a lower 1 bed average ($1,899 against our $2,027).
  • The Core Scottsdale and Broadstone ask less per square foot.
  • Move in cost is $325 against $300 at both.
What wins them back: our 4.5 rating, the work from home lounge, rooftop deck and pet spa, and up to 11 weeks free.

Broadstone Scottsdale Quarter: up to 8 weeks free on select apartments. The Core Scottsdale: reduced 2 bedroom rates plus 50% off the first 3 months. Residences Kierland: up to 8 weeks free. Ours: up to 11 weeks free on select lease terms.

The rivals leasing fastest: Broadstone Scottsdale Quarter (5.0 a week), The Core Scottsdale (4.4), Residences Kierland (3.8), Modera Kierland (3.6) and Azur (3.4). Huxley signs 3.4 a week, above the 2.7 rival average.
Our 1 bedroom average asking rent is $2,027 and 2 bedroom $2,644. Broadstone and The Core ask less per square foot in every bedroom type both offer. Residences Kierland asks more.
4.5 stars from 29 Google reviews. The five newest are all 5 stars and every one has a reply.
